values.note: 2026: water & electric site (tent or RV) $40 a night ($240/week, $625/month), basic full hookup $46, deluxe full hookup $49, premium (50-amp, asphalt pad) and pull-through full hookup $55; rustic tent-only $30 (left out). Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Family Camp, Labor Day) $5 more a night, no discounts. $3.50 reservation fee per booking; Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout. One night's deposit, non-refundable (camp credit only if cancelled 7+ days out).

note: Wesleyan church camp on 160 acres along the Cass River, alcohol- and drug-free, running a state-licensed public RV campground anyone can book by the night; also rustic tent sites, cabins and cottages by a small lake, theme weekends, and canoe and kayak trips on the river. --Claude
summary: Camp's own 2026 rates: $40 water & electric (RV or tent) to $55 premium/pull-through confirmed, $3.50 reservation fee, holiday +$5 with a 3-night minimum (recorded in min_stay); 226 sites (120 full hookup) confirmed, 50-amp confirmed; season May 1 - Oct 15 confirmed. A 'state licensed public RV campground': ordinary public nightly camping on Campspot (130 RV site types offered), not retreat/member-only; seasonal and group stays by phone. Added max rig 60 ft and pull-through from the Campspot record, Campspot /book/ url. Phone 989-823-8840 matches. No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here. Note cleaned of the full-hookup count (now in sites.note).
